events.title: 태어나다
events.description: 1957년에 태어났다. 출생지에 대한 기록은 널리 알려져 있지 않다.
events.description_en: He was born in 1957. His exact birthplace is not widely documented.

events.title: 스탠퍼드에서 심리학을 마치다
events.description: 스탠퍼드대학교에서 심리학 학사를 마쳤다. 동물의 학습 실험에 흥미를 느낀 것이 뒤에 강화학습 연구로 이어졌다.
events.description_en: He earned his bachelor's degree in psychology at Stanford University. His interest in animal learning experiments later carried over into his work on reinforcement learning.

events.title: 매사추세츠대에서 박사학위를 받다
events.title_en: He earned his doctorate at UMass Amherst
events.description: 매사추세츠대학교 애머스트에서 컴퓨터과학 박사학위를 받았다. 강화학습에서 시간 간격을 둔 신용 할당 문제를 다룬 논문이었고, 액터-크리틱 구조를 여기서 처음 제시했다.
events.description_en: He earned his PhD in computer science at the University of Massachusetts Amherst. His dissertation tackled the problem of temporal credit assignment in reinforcement learning and introduced the actor-critic architecture.

events.title: GTE 연구소에서 강화학습을 연구하다
events.title_en: He researched reinforcement learning at GTE Laboratories
events.description: GTE 연구소의 수석 연구원으로 강화학습 이론을 산업 현장에서도 발전시켰다.
events.description_en: As a principal researcher at GTE Laboratories, he continued developing reinforcement learning theory in an industry setting.

events.title: 시간차 학습 이론을 발표하다
events.title_en: He published the theory of temporal-difference learning
events.description: 과거 경험만으로 미래를 예측하도록 학습하는 시간차 학습 방법을 발표했다. 이 이론은 이후 강화학습 알고리즘 대부분의 뼈대가 되었다.
events.description_en: He published temporal-difference learning, a method that lets a system learn to predict the future from past experience alone. The theory became the backbone of most reinforcement learning algorithms that followed.

events.title: 강화학습 교과서를 앤드루 바르토와 함께 펴내다
events.title_en: He co-authored the reinforcement learning textbook with Andrew Barto
events.description: 앤드루 바르토와 함께 '강화학습 개론'을 펴냈다. 이 책은 이후 이 분야의 표준 교과서로 자리 잡았다.
events.description_en: He and Andrew Barto published Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction. The book became the standard textbook of the field.

events.title: 앨버타대 교수가 되어 연구실을 이끌다
events.title_en: He became a professor at the University of Alberta and led a lab
events.description: 캐나다 앨버타대학교 교수로 자리를 옮겨 강화학습·인공지능연구실을 이끌었다.
events.description_en: He moved to a professorship at the University of Alberta in Canada, where he led the Reinforcement Learning and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory.

events.title: 딥마인드 연구원이 되어 앨버타 연구소를 열다
events.title_en: He became a DeepMind scientist and helped open its Alberta lab
events.description: 구글 딥마인드의 특훈연구원을 겸하며 앨버타대와 손잡은 딥마인드 앨버타 연구소를 여는 데 함께했다.
events.description_en: He took on a role as a distinguished research scientist at Google DeepMind while also helping launch DeepMind Alberta, a lab run in partnership with the university.

events.title: 딥마인드 앨버타 연구소가 닫히자 킨테크놀로지스로 옮기다
events.title_en: He moved to Keen Technologies after DeepMind closed the Alberta lab
events.description: 딥마인드가 앨버타 연구소를 닫자 게임 엔지니어 존 카맥이 세운 킨테크놀로지스로 자리를 옮겼다. 인간처럼 계속 학습하는 인공지능을 목표로 삼았다.
events.description_en: When DeepMind closed the Alberta lab, he moved to Keen Technologies, a company founded by game engineer John Carmack. The goal there was building an artificial intelligence that keeps learning the way a human does.

events.title: 앤드루 바르토와 튜링상을 받다
events.title_en: He received the Turing Award with Andrew Barto
events.description: 강화학습의 이론과 알고리즘 기반을 세운 공로로 앤드루 바르토와 함께 튜링상을 받았다.
events.description_en: He received the Turing Award together with Andrew Barto for laying the conceptual and algorithmic foundations of reinforcement learning.
